name: India EO Query Benchmark — held-out set
description: Twenty queries written after routing reached 100% on the development set, deliberately in phrasings and regions that were never used for tuning. Run ONCE. Whatever it scores is the reported figure.
protocol: The prompt in routing.py must not be changed in response to these results. If it is, this set is spent and a new one is required. The development-set score of 100% reflects four rounds of prompt tuning against that set and overstates real performance; this set exists to produce a number that does not.
differences_from_development_set: No region reused from the development set
Relative date expressions ('two years back', 'last winter')
Out-of-scope cases of new kinds: advice-seeking, prediction, causation

fields.question: what a user would type
fields.analysis_type: expected analysis, or null when out of scope
fields.region: place name that should be extracted, or null
fields.region_resolvable: whether it exists in FAO GAUL 2015; absent means true
fields.comparison: true when the question asks for change
fields.period_contains: a date the window must include, or null
